source: KFGQPC Uthmanic Script HAFS text (King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, Madinah mushaf), via the Quran Foundation API (api.quran.com v4, text_qpc_hafs). Verbatim; only the trailing ayah number was removed (the app renders it). Display-only edition paired with the KFGQPC HAFS font; recitation analysis uses the Tanzil text.
ayat: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ
وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
